body:

GO:0043188 | cell septum edging | IEA with ARBA00084425
GO:0000936 | primary cell septum | IEA with ARBA00092954


* **Description of issue**

I would prefer not to make these annotations - these are transferred from the paralog gas2, which is likely to have undergone sub-functionalization.

If  gas1 was cell sptum edging  it would probably have been published here

https://www.pombase.org/reference/PMID:21124977


It looks strange to make such an annotation  with no evidence, because it cannot be predicted from the available data. Parlogs often have different locations (otherwise why would they be retained?)

author: Antonialock
body:
gas1 is annotated to cell septum edging and primary cell septum by BHF-UCL
https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/annotations?geneProductId=Q9P378&assignedBy=BHF-UCL&aspect=cellular_component

BHF UCL also made manual annotations to gas2
https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/annotations?geneProductId=Q9USU5&assignedBy=BHF-UCL&aspect=cellular_component

I think if you dispute these annotations the ARBA annotations will disappear, these entries are experimental masters for the rule.
